rendering: chat template (system+user), add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False, + forced 'Answer:' prefix — identical to phase8a_final_modal.render

position_classes.carry_entity: final token of the entity-mention (person name) span in each CARRY (holds) clause; k=3 per episode
position_classes.fact_final: final token of each fact clause (token containing the clause-final '.'); 6 clauses path P, 7 path G
position_classes.query_arg: final token of the query-argument mention: {mark} in path P, {sym} in path G; 1 per episode
position_classes.answer: last token of the rendered prompt ('Answer:' forced prefix) — 8A/8C answer position, continuity; 1 per episode

padding_note: indices are into the UNPADDED rendered prompt; under left padding the in-session index = index + (padded_len - rendered_len)
